visual_vibe: Technical, Data Vault, Industrial, Precise. Flat surfaces, exposed grids, sharp corners.

typography.headings: text-2xl to text-4xl, font-bold, tracking-tight, uppercase for section headers.
typography.data_display: font-mono, text-sm or text-xs, tracking-tight for hashes, sizes, and paths.

rules: No dark text on dark backgrounds anywhere. Minimum APCA contrast must be met.
Use border-white/10 or border-zinc-800 for grid lines.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and compact for data, generous for main layout sections (p-6 to p-12).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse patterns. 1px solid borders on cards and sections. 0 border-radius (rounded-none for sharp edges).
layout_and_spacing.background_texture: Use a subtle CSS grid background for the empty space: bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:24px_24px]

upload_zone.style: Brutalist dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-700), bg-zinc-950. Hover: border-orange-500 bg-orange-500/5.
upload_zone.typography: Large mono text: 'INITIALIZE INGESTION' or 'DROP FILES'. Real-time SHA-256 calculation simulated with mono loading states.

duplicate_alert_modal.style: Terminal warning style. Thick red top border (border-t-4 border-red-500). Black background. Sharp edges.
duplicate_alert_modal.content: Red mono heading '[!] COLLISION DETECTED'. Display existing file path in a well-contrasted mono block (bg-red-950/30 text-red-400 p-4 border border-red-900/50).

data_tables.style: Cardless, full-width. border-b border-zinc-800 on rows. Compact padding (py-2 px-4).
data_tables.typography: Headers in uppercase IBM Plex Sans text-xs text-zinc-500. Hashes in IBM Plex Mono text-zinc-400 text-xs truncate. Badges for file types: flat, 1px border, text-xs mono.

stat_cards.style: Square/Rectangular bento blocks. 1px border border-zinc-800. bg-zinc-950.
stat_cards.content: Value: text-4xl font-mono font-medium. Label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-zinc-500. No icons needed, pure typographic data focus.

filter_chips.style: Sharp rectangular buttons. border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 bg-transparent. Active state: bg-white text-black font-bold.

global_search.style: Full width or prominent top bar. Sharp input, border-b-2 border-zinc-800 focus:border-orange-500. No rounded corners. Monospace placeholder.

motion.hover: Instant background color shifts, no slow transitions. High technical responsiveness.
motion.modals: Harsh snap-in, no soft scaling. Opacity 0 to 100 instantly, mimicking a terminal popup.

icons.usage: Ensure strokeWidth is 1.5 or 1 for technical precision. Use sparingly. Rely on typographic symbols like [ ] or > where possible.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement using pure .js and standard React. Do not use TypeScript.
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Import IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono fonts via Google Fonts in index.css.
Customize Shadcn UI to remove all border-radius (use rounded-none) and soft shadows. Replace with sharp 1px borders.
Ensure the SHA-256 generation in the drop zone is visually indicated (mock the calculation state with flickering mono text).
Do not leave any placeholder text or generic lorem ipsum.
Read this JSON carefully and map all elements to the requested 'Data Vault / Control Room' aesthetic.
